subject: Mathematics

source.subtopic: Count forwards and backwards in 1s from any number between 1 and 50 (weeks 1-2), 60 (weeks 3-4), 70 (weeks 5-6) and 80 (weeks 7-10)

show.line: Start anywhere and count on! Twenty seven, twenty eight, twenty nine, thirty. Now backwards. Thirty, twenty nine.

rounds.prompt: Count on. Thirty three, thirty four, thirty five, and then?
Start at eighteen and count on. Eighteen, nineteen, and then?
Count backwards. Forty two, forty one, forty, and then?
Which number comes just after twenty nine?
Which number comes just before fifty?
Count back from twenty three. Twenty three, twenty two, and then?

hints: Say the tens, then the ones. Thirty, then six.
After nine ones comes a new ten. Twenty nine, thirty.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will count on from thirty eight.
beat_the_tutor.tutor_try: Thirty eight, thirty nine, thirty ten!
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! After thirty nine comes forty.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's count together. Thirty eight, thirty nine, forty!

parent_line: Can count forwards and backwards from any number up to 50.
